notes.title: Release 1.5.0 has crossed the finish line!
notes.content:
What has changed?
Release 1.5.0 is finally here!

I've got so many changes for you... really not sure where I should begin.

Network Gameplay
The biggest change is the network layer. Here I changed the library from PUN 2 to Fishnet, which has a lot more features.
For example, you now got LAN multiplayer!!! Do you remember the good old times?

Also, it's now deeply integrated into Steam, means you can easily join a race of a friend, if he has an open lobby.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166188/fa4cd219bf1eab1c717697c6b174aa06353b913a.jpg
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166188/b8ecbf8699ba9b638cb319a0bfe76c76309d8266.jpg

[hr][/hr]

Complete List of Changes
Here's everything that's been updated:

Improvements

 New Network Library
 LAN multiplayer now available
 Reworked hit points animation
 Reworked stunt hit animation
 Reworked on screen comic text
 Reworked explosions
 New in-game ads are displayed
 UI: small improvements for the main menu
 UI: Highlighting own player in statistics after race or grand prix finished
 Upgraded Unity version
 Reworked Track "Watch Out For Trains"
 Camera Zoom can be changed with gamepad / keyboard and can be different for each splitscreen player
 A lot of smaller improvements all over the game


Bug Fixes

 Hiding now the username above vehicle on explosion
 On own explosion, the camera was "falling" through the ground
 Usernames above players, were sometimes not blended out correctly
 MacOS: Resolution was not saved and restored correctly after restart of the game
 Various small fixes all over the game


[hr][/hr]

What is Next?
I’ll be keeping an eye on the new network implementation, and if any issues arise, I’ll address them as needed.

In the meantime, I’ll also be diving into some research - learning new things and experimenting with fresh game ideas. Not sure where this journey will take me yet, but I’m excited to explore!

notes.title: Status Update Dezember
notes.content:
Hey Everyone,

I’ve been pretty quiet the last few weeks, but now it’s time for an update! ☺️
So, what’s been going on? What am I working on?

New Network Library
As mentioned before, I’ve been hard at work migrating to a new network library. There are several reasons for this:


 Better performance
 Lower monthly costs
 Local network gameplay (good old LAN without needing internet!)


The last point is still open for discussion, but it’s now possible with the new library! 😃 Let me know if this is something you’d like to see.

Various Improvements
I’m also focused on improving the game across the board. My goal is to refine the existing gameplay rather than adding brand-new features. Here's what I’ve been working on:


 Revamped main menu user interface
 Enhanced UI feedback during races (PowerUps, crashes, etc.)
 A new AI system for racers
 A better panorama camera for 4-player split-screen games
 Improvements to the new camera views (currently available in beta mode - check settings)
 And more...


All of these updates will be included in release 1.5.0, along with the new network library, making for an overall improved game experience!

When is the new update expected?
That’s a tricky question. Right now, I’m aiming for a January/February release next year. If necessary, I might split the update and move some features to a later release - let’s see how it goes!

You might wonder, “Why not finish one topic first?”
The answer is that migrating to the new network library requires a lot of testing with friends. While waiting between test sessions, I tackle smaller improvements to make the most of my time. Most of these enhancements will be part of release 1.5.0.


Stay tuned, and thanks for your patience! 😊

notes.title: Status Update :: What's next?
notes.content:
What am I working on?

I'll keep it brief: There’s some good news, and some not-so-good news...

Let's start with the good ones

As a surprise, I'm developing a brand new racing track, set to release next month! Here's an exclusive sneak peek of the track in progress:

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166188/cf6831baf8774e8b1bbb1ccb6535ee867aeda88a.png

Now for the bad news
The next update, which focuses on network improvements, was originally slated for September. However, due to unforeseen circumstances, it's going to be delayed.

Wait... What?!
Yes, unfortunately, I need to push back the release. While I’m still determining the exact timing, it won’t be ready before December or January 2025, that much is certain.

Up until now, I’ve managed to meet every deadline (which I’m quite proud of) and delivered numerous features in the first year since release. However, this time, things haven't gone as planned. There are several reasons for the delay:

[olist]
 The new network library is vastly different from the current one, so there's a learning curve involved.
 Much of the existing code needs to be reworked—not only to integrate with the new library but also to clean up the current codebase.
 Since this development happens in my free time, other priorities in my personal life have taken precedence lately.
[/olist]

In short: I'm on it, but it’s going to take a bit longer. I appreciate your patience and ongoing support!

September Contest

On a brighter note, don’t forget about the current contest! You still have time to participate until the end of September in the leaderboard event for a chance to win a Steam Key for "Electro Ride: The Neon Racing"!

Check out the intermediate results, and let’s see your best lap times!

New PowerUps
CPU Powered
CPU controlled fast driving on the track. That is for those on the last places to catch up with the others.

God's Protection
You are immune to the power up's Sleepy, Icy Surface and Anchor and it will end those effects immediately.

Beta Test
On the "Camera" tab in the settings menu, you can now find the section "Beta Test" and enable it, to test out 2 new camera views.
You can switch the camera view in game with the Q key on the keyboard or the "View Button" on the gamepad. Check settings for more and to change the keyboard button.

I'm aware, that there are several things to be improved with these views, but if you want to test those out, please give me feedback.

The next update will take some time - as I already mentioned in the roadmap. I will work on improvements on the network layer. Really hard to say how long it will take, as it is quite some work. And there is also holiday season. I'm really looking forward to enjoy some time with my family 😊

notes.title: Steam Integration - Achievements, Cloudsave, Friend Invite
notes.content:
In the last days we added some Steam features which everyone knows and likes.

Achievements
We included 22 achievements for you to collect. One is hidden - let's see how many people will find it 😁

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166188/eb18e62377e01559ac409bf206462c1d2f95d8f5.png

Steam Cloud Save
If you are moving from your PC to your laptop. Or you want to continue playing on a complete new device - don't fear. All your progress is now synced with the steam cloud and you will not loss any progress.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43166188/3c960e79b7a7373ee55e5909c59095e4efdc6cc3.png

Steam Friend Invite
Now it's easy to invite your friends to Smells Like Burnt Rubber. Just two clicks for you and one for your friends - and you can race for gold!
